integrity: All exact-rational dual, characteristic-polynomial and exhaustive six-column checks passed. Published priority and independent mathematical assessment are not certified.
limitations: The finite-size energy and degeneracy classifications require a circumference divisible by three; the general-length claim is only the ground-energy density limit. Fixed three-color, homogeneous-bond, equal-strength staggered row fields are assumed. No positive-temperature phase transition is claimed.
title: Two sharp entropy spikes for a row-staggered three-state Potts antiferromagnet
